data.description:
## Context
Story: a9d7-3088-9f3f-4f10 — Bug-Fix Mode commits to sub-branch; remove cross-mode 'uniformly' language

## Goal
Update SKILL.md: (1) Bug-Fix Mode per-ticket loop reads DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: anchor and commits to that sub-branch; (2) remove 'uniformly' cross-mode preamble language; (3) Bug-Fix Mode section header has explicit sub-branch instructions.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify | tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-bugfix-subbranch.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Find Bug-Fix Mode per-ticket loop in SKILL.md
2. After each fix-bug invocation, add:
   'Resolve current sub-branch from the most-recent DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: anchor (per S7 COMPACTION_RESUME pattern):
   _branch=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment-list <epic-id> | grep "^DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: " | tail -1 | sed "s/DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: sub_branch=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/")
   If _branch is non-empty, commit fix-bug output to that sub-branch (not the session branch).'
3. Add to Bug-Fix Mode section header: explicit sub-branch instructions (ci-pr mode: commit to sub-branch; local mode: commit to session branch)
4. Remove any 'uniformly' language from the debug-everything preamble that implies a shared cross-mode sub-branch preamble

Remove RED markers for test_bugfix_mode_* and test_no_cross_mode_uniformly_language from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode references DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: anchor for sub-branch resolution
- SKILL.md states fix-bug output committed to current sub-branch
- SKILL.md preamble does NOT contain 'uniformly' as cross-mode sub-branch language
- Bug-Fix Mode section header has sub-branch instructions
- All 4 structural tests pass GREEN
- ruff checks pass
data.title: T2: Update SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode for sub-branch routing and per-mode instruction co-location (GREEN)
